answer: To enter the haven registry, an identity needs endorsements from three falcon notaries. Each notary stakes 200 POA, charges 20 POA, and may endorse two identities per epoch. A convicted fake slashes its three notaries 200 POA each and bans them three epochs, so notaries inspect rather than rubber-stamp. Ten sockpuppets need thirty endorsements: 600 POA in fees plus slashing risk, and the epoch cap forces recruiting many notaries or waiting many epochs in an ocean of applicants. The chain verifies signatures and escrow from the public ledger and auto-slashes on conviction.
